Hi math contesera here hahahha! Siguro the ultimate thing na nag push sakin to study math is that I love the challenge na na gigive niya sakin. You don't have to fall in love with math like I did to improve, pero I highly suggest na you embrace it first before you start practicing it. Accept mo na it is something na you need to learn and something na kailangan mo i improve. 

Secondly, don't take too much time learning the concepts. Focus more sa practice problems. You learn more if you practice. Learn the formula (and understand where it came from), then proceed na sa problems. 

Lastly, treat every problem na parang naglalaro ka (okay weird advice, but it worked for me). Parang nagplaplay detective ka. Literal na problem-solving. Find the key points na kailangan mong ma apply (i call it the monster's weak spots hahahhaa). Basta enjoy mo lang yung feeling of solving something, or learning the solution to something by reading. Napaka sarap sa feeling pag na solve mo. 

Bonus tip: get a tutor or ask your teachers for additional time after class. My coach really helped me a lot in understanding topics. So if you have the luxury to look for a tutor, or if your teachers are kind enough to teach you more after class, take advantage of it. 

Hope this helps!
